verdict.rationale: jo documents its own set of wired-up integrations, including GitHub, Linear and a Slack-style channel catchup, and refers to the user's connected context and to connecting things. That shows users can attach some first-party connectors. There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps that can be added. Missing for 10: a browsable connector/app directory, support for adding arbitrary third-party apps beyond the fixed integration list, documentation of the in-app add/connect flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
